findings.title: Required real-provider official and unofficial IN/OUT gate remains unexecuted
findings.rationale: The package correctly distinguishes controlled-provider, real-BFF/PostgreSQL evidence from external-provider proof, but DOD-07 and VAL-04 still require fresh post-activation official and unofficial operator IN/OUT. No waiver is supplied, so automated fixture success cannot close the delivery-integrity gap.
findings.suggested_action: After authorized local activation and HTTPS restoration, collect fresh redacted IN/OUT and canonical readback evidence for both owned bindings against the reviewed source. Keep remote CI separately not_run unless later authorized promotion executes it.

findings.title: Public availability contract lacks negative-path and thread-endpoint regression coverage
findings.rationale: The public controller adds `envio_disponivel` and `motivo_indisponibilidade` to both list and thread responses, but the supplied `api-publica.e2e-spec.ts` asserts only an available list row. A broken or omitted thread projection, or an unavailable selected binding reported as available, can pass all supplied tests despite violating D07 and the public contract.
findings.suggested_action: Add real-PostgreSQL public API tests covering available and deterministic unavailable selected bindings. Assert exact list and thread availability/reason fields, then assert POST blocks without provider calls or a new OUT Message for the unavailable case.
